history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#596; borg-reborn-rs #842, PR #847). Pilot (RULES 16)
on classes-18, eight arms (the five the owner asked for and the three the local replays raised), 18 starts each (144
games), all classes, one binary; small + medium (classes-1800 starts 1-360) after the gate and the owner.
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; ctl plays as the build's shipped settings (the
eight crow deaths of 3b4924ba replay key for key in the requester's smoke); every cell ends in death, turn_cap or
borg_stopped; stalls reported start by start (the lightless abort seen in #581 and #586 is a separate family); frozen-turn
bursts classified.
Report per arm and class: deaths and causes (crow and wild cat deaths apart), CL at death, final and maximum level,
deepest level; paired rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), identical plays; cure potions used per crow
fight; the other fast-fragile deaths (cave spiders, centipedes, bats: fde8025a had 16 of 33 deaths in this family) and
what the "# Fast-fragile (stats)" notes mark (the monsters and the numbers); whether the 8 cases of #842 change. The
numbers (2 turns, 25%, 2 others, +5 speed) and escape_percent are hypotheses. Descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs 7f8c6b80 (PR #847), does attacking a fast-fragile monster (crow, wild cat, by name or by stats) with the best attack every turn, with and without a ban on healing next to it and with the Phase Door or stairs alternative at 100, 75 or 0 percent, save the early deaths (a crow killed 8 of #566's 29) without adding new ones?
